name: non-minimal-proof-offset
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: The head's offset to `proof` points 32 bytes past the canonical position, with the length word duplicated there so a lenient decoder still finds an empty proof and reports success. Two encodings of one value is one encoding too many when the value is going to be hashed; canonical form refuses it.
